title: SPEKTRAN: an open simulation engine, data standard, and ML benchmark for TDLAS
description: Open-source simulation engine, data standard, and benchmark suite for machine learning on tunable diode laser absorption spectroscopy (TDLAS). Generates physically rigorous, fully reproducible synthetic spectra with realistic instrument noise and defines standardized tasks for concentration regression, spectral denoising, and cross-instrument generalization.
notes: Code is Apache-2.0; generated datasets and the data schema are CC BY 4.0. Dataset archives deposited separately with their own DOI at each major release.
